gloss: to reduce; to shrink; to scale down

definitions.gloss: to reduce in size; to shrink; to scale down
definitions.explanation: To make something smaller in scale, scope, or size, or for something to become smaller on its own.

examples.japanese: {画像|がぞう}を{縮小|しゅくしょう}する。
examples.english: To reduce the size of an image.

examples.japanese: {事業|じぎょう}{規模|きぼ}を{縮小|しゅくしょう}することになった。
examples.english: It was decided to scale down the business.

examples.japanese: {少子化|しょうしか}で{市場|しじょう}が{縮小|しゅくしょう}し{続|つづ}けている。
examples.english: The market continues to shrink due to the declining birth rate.

examples.japanese: コロナの{影響|えいきょう}で{多|おお}くの{企業|きぎょう}が{事業|じぎょう}を{縮小|しゅくしょう}せざるを{得|え}なかった。
examples.english: Due to the impact of COVID, many companies had no choice but to scale down their operations.

notes:
The opposite of {拡大|かくだい}する (to expand). Used for both physical reduction (images, maps) and abstract reduction (business, scope). Can be transitive (someone shrinks something) or intransitive (something shrinks on its own).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {規模|きぼ}を{縮小|しゅくしょう}する: to scale down the size
- {事業|じぎょう}{縮小|しゅくしょう}: business downsizing
- {縮小|しゅくしょう}{傾向|けいこう}: shrinking trend
- {縮小|しゅくしょう}{均衡|きんこう}: shrinking equilibrium
- {拡大|かくだい}{縮小|しゅくしょう}: enlargement and reduction; zoom in/out

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {削減|さくげん}する: to cut, to reduce — focuses on deliberate cutting, often budgets or personnel
- {減少|げんしょう}する: to decrease — emphasizes numerical decrease
- {圧縮|あっしゅく}する: to compress — implies physical compression or shortening of time/data
